newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek 96 EPS revised downwards 2.3 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Greek 96 EPS revised downwards 2.3 pct in August.

text.p: Financial analysts revised their 1996 earnings per share (EPS) estimates of a universe of 56 listed Greek equities downwards by 2.3 percent, Paris-based Associes en Finance said in its August consensus report.
"1996 EPS estimates were revised downwards by 2.3 percent with a negative balance of revisions, 38 upward revisions and 85 downward ones," it said.
The 1995-1996 EPS growth rate stands at 16 percent versus 18.8 percent last month, it said.
The average P/E ratio of the consensus universe in weighted calculations based on 1996 EPS was 9.3 in August versus 9.4 in July, it said.

The EPS consensus was based on forecasts contributed by the following 10 brokerage firms: Alpha Brokerage, Baring Securities, Carnegie International, N.D. Devletoglou Securities, Eurosec, National Securities, Olympic Securities, Schroder Securities, Sigma Securities, Telesis Securities.
